_doc: Real-time travel. Trip minutes = minutesAtRef * (lightYears / refLy) ^ exponent: Alpha Centauri about 45 minutes, 12 ly about 10 hours, a beacon (25-43 ly) about 3 to 10 days. fuel (Embers from the planet you leave) = fuelBase + fuelPerLy * lightYears. needCopy: someone has to stay behind, so you can only launch from a planet that has at least one copy. ?fast in the URL turns minutes into seconds for testing.

starLight._doc: Light color of each spectral class (first letter), mixed into a world's darkness color and sky.
